our_title: Hoboken Rent Control: cost-of-living increase cap (Code § 155-5)
our_notes: Section 155-5 is marked 'Amended 2-1-2023 by Ord. No. B-532'. Month of adoption; exact effective date not stated in source (NJ ordinances generally take effect after final passage and publication). The pre-2023 text and original cap are not shown, so it is unclear whether the 2023 amendment changed the 5%/CPI value. § 155-4 (amended through Ord. B-818, 10-22-2025) requires 30 days' written notice with reasons for any increase.  A disclosure statement and a two-year limitation on refunds also apply.  This document does not cover vacancy decontrol or applicability.  It also does not mention the NJ FAIR Act.  Tax, water/sewer, capital and hardship surcharges are addressed in §§ 155-6 to 155-14.  Those are folded into this record.  They do not create separate records.  No other category is addressed in this document.  The 33 1/3% cap is noted under interaction.  It is not a separate headline value.  The Article's other sections are procedural.  The Board's review timing is in § 155-17.  Nothing else here changes the headline cap.

our_notes: Measure BB passed in the November 2024 election; the document states no operative date for the eviction changes, so effective_date is null. Notice of Tenant Rights applies to tenancies started on or after 2024-12-20, which is an application date, not an effective date.
